summary.en: A message travels one connector: it slides out from under one part, rests whole in the gap, slides under the next; its colour says who wrote it.
summary.zh: 消息走过一条连线：从一个部件下面滑出，在空隙里完整停一下，再滑进下一个部件下面；颜色表示谁写的。

fits: One hop of a message between two parts; the steps of a request.
notFor: Flows of many packets at once (use path-flow).

intent.en: Give the eye one still, whole label per hop, so the viewer reads what moved before it moves on.
intent.zh: 每一跳给眼睛一个静止、完整的标签，观众读到是什么在动再继续。

content.en: Two parts, the connector between them and one message chip.
content.zh: 两个部件、它们之间的连线和一条消息签。

fits.zh: 消息在两个部件之间的一跳；一次请求的各步。

notFor.zh: 同时很多数据包的流动（用 path-flow）。

en: Every hop between two parts gets a hold, or the chip is whole for only a few frames.
First rounds slow (0.6–1 s a hop), repeated rounds about 0.5 s.
zh: 每一跳都要有停顿，否则消息签只有几帧是完整的。
第一轮慢（每跳 0.6–1 秒），重复的轮次约 0.5 秒。

overlaps.note: many glowing packets into one sink (keynote); here one labelled chip that rests in the gap

waive.all: an own brick split from teach-video's blueprint-zoom kit: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the kit's approved example film at the same moments (the style's recipe, card: Differs from upstream)

endsMoving.reason: the chip slides under the receiving part at speed (power2.in) and is hidden there once 35 % covered, as the kit's travel does; the part takes over on that frame
